primary_task: Scaffold a ChatGPT Apps SDK app (MCP server plus widget) for one use case, after fetching the current Apps SDK docs, and validate it locally.

requirements.name: OpenAI developer docs (developers.openai.com) via $openai-docs skill, OpenAI docs MCP server, or direct URL fetch
requirements.evidence: ## Mandatory Docs-First Workflow ... 1. Invoke `$openai-docs` (preferred) or call the OpenAI docs MCP server directly. 2. Fetch current Apps SDK docs before writing code ... 7. If doc search times out or returns poor matches, fetch the canonical Apps SDK pages directly by URL (alternatives: any of the three)
requirements.basis: "lacks": "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused"

requirements.name: openaiDeveloperDocs MCP server
requirements.basis: "lacks": "connectors or integrations other than the tools listed"

requirements.name: $openai-docs skill
requirements.evidence: Use `$openai-docs` first whenever building or changing a ChatGPT Apps SDK app.
requirements.basis: "skill": "load an installed Claude Code skill, list and search skills and plugins" -- the manifest does not list installed skills; check whether openai-docs is installed and whether it needs developers.openai.com.

requirements.name: node / npm (@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps)
requirements.basis: "bash": "... install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)"

requirements.name: github.com (official OpenAI / ext-apps examples)
requirements.evidence: Check the official OpenAI examples first ... Use `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` examples

requirements.name: ngrok + ChatGPT Developer Mode
requirements.evidence: test the app in ChatGPT developer mode through HTTPS tunneling ... (for example `ngrok http <port>`)
requirements.basis: "lacks": "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (... SaaS products ...)"

notes: Took the literal reading: the docs-first workflow is labelled "Mandatory" and says to fetch current Apps SDK docs "before writing code"; every listed route (the $openai-docs skill, the OpenAI docs MCP server, direct URL fetch) reaches OpenAI's docs host, which is outside the allow-list. Under the other reading (item 7: "do not let search failure block scaffolding" lets the agent proceed without docs, or $openai-docs is installed with offline content), the scaffold can be built from GitHub examples and npm packages and the verdict would be ACHIEVABLE. ChatGPT Developer Mode testing and ngrok are runtime checks "when feasible"/setup instructions in the reply, not hard. Unknown: $openai-docs skill installation.
